subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session Gateway-backed CLI dispatches return a terminal lane-busy result after the wait threshold, or keep waiting and only improve timeout/error text?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the candidate fix changes the CLI delivery contract by intentionally rejecting some queued agent messages instead of letting them continue waiting.

options.title: Terminal Busy Result
options.body: Accept the linked PR direction: return a structured lane-busy stderr/JSON result for opted-in CLI dispatches while keeping non-CLI Gateway calls unopted.

options.title: Wait With Better Timeout
options.body: Keep queued CLI delivery semantics and only surface clearer timeout/busy diagnostics when the existing wait eventually fails.

options.title: Pause The Fix
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers define a broader lane scheduling and CLI orchestration contract.

recommendation.title: Terminal Busy Result
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR direction: return a structured lane-busy stderr/JSON result for opted-in CLI dispatches while keeping non-CLI Gateway calls unopted.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Gateway-routed agent CLI path and several adjacent CLI/Gateway refactors trace to this history.
